left join a on info.CHB_ISSUER_ID=a.ASSET_CODE left join b on info.CHB_ISSUER_ID=b.ASSET_CODE
left join a on pos.ASSET_CODE=a.ASSET_CODE left join b on pos.ASSET_CODE=b.ASSET_CODE

and pos.prod_id in

group by #{bookdate,jdbcType=DATE},#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE}, pos.INVEST_VARIETY,pos.trade_type,pos.IS_UNDER_TRADE, pos.ASSET_CODE, pos.PROD_ID, pos.chl_id, pos.CCY, decode(pos.ASSET_CODE,'REMAININGCASH','01',info.asset_type), decode(pos.ASSET_CODE,'REMAININGCASH','1001',info.ASSET_TYPE2), nvl(nvl(info.PRO_INDUSTRY,info.INDUSTRY1),info.INDUSTRY_SHARES),info.IN_ASSET_TYPE, null,nvl(nvl(c.rating ,d.rating),nvl(a.rating,b.rating)), decode(info.PRIVATE_FLAG,'01','01',null), decode(info.PPPFLAG,'01','01',null), decode(info.IS_GOVERN_FUND,'01','01',null), decode(info.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG,'01','01',null), decode(info.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG,'01','01',null), decode(info.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG,'01','01',null), info.MANAGE_TYPE, prd.IS_FHXGCP

select #{bookdate,jdbcType=DATE} bookdate ,#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} enddate ,pos.INVEST_VARIETY ,pos.trade_type ,pos.IS_UNDER_TRADE ,pos.ASSET_CODE ,pos.PROD_ID ,pos.chl_id chlid ,pos.CCY ,info.asset_type assettype ,info.ASSET_TYPE2 assettype2 ,nvl(nvl(info.PRO_INDUSTRY,info.INDUSTRY1),info.INDUSTRY_SHARES) INDUSTRY1 /*所属行业*/ ,info.IN_ASSET_TYPE ,sum(pos.accuamt) ASSETVALUE_A /*穿透前资产价值*/ ,sum(pos.accuamt) ASSETVALUE_B /*穿透后资产价值*/ ,nvl(nvl(c.rating ,d.rating),nvl(a.rating,b.rating)) rating/*债券评级*/ ,decode(info.PRIVATE_FLAG,'01','01',null) MONIT_TYPE ,decode(info.PPPFLAG,'01','01',null) PPPFLAG ,decode(info.IS_GOVERN_FUND,'01','01',null) IS_GOVERN_FUND1 ,decode(info.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG,'01','01',null) PRIVATEFUND_FLAG ,decode(info.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG,'01','01',null) PRIVATEPRD_FLAG ,decode(info.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG,'01','01',null) BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG ,info.MANAGE_TYPE MANAGE_TYPE /*管理方式*/ from CHB_ASSET_POSITION pos left join CHB_ASSET_INFO info on pos.ASSET_CODE=info.ASSET_CODE and info.status !='D'
left join a on info.CHB_ISSUER_ID=a.ASSET_CODE left join b on info.CHB_ISSUER_ID=b.ASSET_CODE
left join a on pos.ASSET_CODE=a.ASSET_CODE left join b on pos.ASSET_CODE=b.ASSET_CODE
left join c on pos.ASSET_CODE=c.ASSET_CODE left join d on pos.ASSET_CODE=d.ASSET_CODE left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=pos.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where 1=1 and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' and pos.trade_type in ('01','02') /*直投交易,通道交易,资管计划交易*/ and pos.cDATE =#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} and pos.prod_id = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and pos.CHL_ID = #{chlId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by #{bookdate,jdbcType=DATE},#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE}, pos.INVEST_VARIETY,pos.trade_type,pos.IS_UNDER_TRADE, pos.ASSET_CODE, pos.PROD_ID, pos.chl_id, pos.CCY, info.asset_type, info.ASSET_TYPE2, nvl(nvl(info.PRO_INDUSTRY,info.INDUSTRY1),info.INDUSTRY_SHARES),info.IN_ASSET_TYPE, null,nvl(nvl(c.rating ,d.rating),nvl(a.rating,b.rating)), decode(info.PRIVATE_FLAG,'01','01',null), decode(info.PPPFLAG,'01','01',null), decode(info.IS_GOVERN_FUND,'01','01',null), decode(info.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG,'01','01',null), decode(info.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG,'01','01',null), decode(info.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG,'01','01',null), info.MANAGE_TYPE

select pos.PLAN_ASSET_ID ,pos.TOTAL_NUM ,pos.ISSUE_AMT ,pos.asset_code ,pos.POS_NUM ,pos.POS_AMT ,pos.POS_DATE ,pos.ISFINAPLAN ,#{accuamt} ACCUAMT from CHB_BOT_AST_POS pos left join CHB_ASSET_INFO info on pos.asset_code=info.asset_code where pos.PLAN_ASSET_ID = #{planAssetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and pos.POS_DATE=#{posDate,jdbcType=DATE} and pos.status !='D' and info.status!='D' and pos.asset_code!='REMAININGCASH'

select #{bookdate,jdbcType=DATE} bookdate ,#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} enddate ,info.asset_type assettype ,info.ASSET_TYPE2 assettype2 ,nvl(nvl(info.PRO_INDUSTRY,info.INDUSTRY1),info.INDUSTRY_SHARES) INDUSTRY1 /*所属行业*/ ,info.IN_ASSET_TYPE ,nvl(nvl(c.rating ,d.rating),nvl(a.rating,b.rating)) rating /*债券评级*/ ,decode(info.PRIVATE_FLAG,'01','01',null) MONIT_TYPE ,decode(info.PPPFLAG,'01','01',null) PPPFLAG ,decode(info.IS_GOVERN_FUND,'01','01',null) IS_GOVERN_FUND1 ,decode(info.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG,'01','01',null) PRIVATEFUND_FLAG ,decode(info.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG,'01','01',null) PRIVATEPRD_FLAG ,decode(info.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG,'01','01',null) BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG ,info.MANAGE_TYPE MANAGE_TYPE /*管理方式*/ from CHB_ASSET_INFO info
left join a on info.CHB_ISSUER_ID=a.ASSET_CODE left join b on info.CHB_ISSUER_ID=b.ASSET_CODE
left join a on info.ASSET_CODE=a.ASSET_CODE left join b on info.ASSET_CODE=b.ASSET_CODE
left join c on info.ASSET_CODE=c.ASSET_CODE left join d on info.ASSET_CODE=d.ASSET_CODE where 1=1 and info.status !='D' and info.ASSET_CODE=#{assetCode,jdbcType=CHAR} group by #{bookdate,jdbcType=DATE},#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE}, info.asset_type, info.ASSET_TYPE2, nvl(nvl(info.PRO_INDUSTRY,info.INDUSTRY1),info.INDUSTRY_SHARES),info.IN_ASSET_TYPE, null,nvl(nvl(c.rating ,d.rating),nvl(a.rating,b.rating)), decode(info.PRIVATE_FLAG,'01','01',null), decode(info.PPPFLAG,'01','01',null), decode(info.IS_GOVERN_FUND,'01','01',null), decode(info.PRIVATEFUND_FLAG,'01','01',null), decode(info.PRIVATEPRD_FLAG,'01','01',null), decode(info.BONDTOSTOCK_FLAG,'01','01',null), info.MANAGE_TYPE

SELECT SUM(cashflow) cashamt,CCY ccy,PROD_ID prodId FROM (SELECT SUM( CASE prdeal.TRADE_TYPE WHEN '03' THEN (NVL(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0)+nvl(prdeal.REDEMPTION_FEE,0)) * -1 WHEN '04' THEN 0 WHEN '05' THEN 0 WHEN '14' THEN 0 WHEN '15' THEN 0 WHEN '16' THEN NVL(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0) * -1 WHEN '17' THEN (NVL(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0)+nvl(prdeal.REDEMPTION_FEE,0)) * -1 ELSE NVL(prdeal.TRADE_PRINCE, 0) END) cashflow, prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID FROM chb_prd_deal prdeal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=prdeal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' WHERE PAY_DATE <=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} AND TRADE_TYPE NOT IN ('05','14','15') and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' AND PRDEAL.STATUS !='D' GROUP BY prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID UNION ALL SELECT SUM( CASE prdeal.TRADE_TYPE WHEN '04' THEN NVL(prdeal.INT_AMT, 0) * -1 ELSE 0 END) cashflow, prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID FROM chb_prd_deal prdeal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=prdeal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' WHERE INTEREST_DATE<=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' AND PRDEAL.STATUS !='D' GROUP BY prdeal.CCY,prdeal.PROD_ID UNION ALL SELECT SUM(-1*NVL(fee.AMT,0 ))cashflow, fee.CCY,fee.PROD_ID FROM chb_prd_fee_deal fee left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=fee.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' WHERE fee.PAY_DATE <=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' AND fee.STATUS !='D' GROUP BY fee.CCY,fee.PROD_ID ) base GROUP BY CCY,PROD_ID

SELECT sum( case when deal.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','03','05','08','10','12') then -1*nvl(deal.AMT,0) else nvl(deal.AMT,0) end ) cashamt ,DEAL.PROD_ID,DEAL.CCY FROM chb_invest_trade deal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=deal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where deal.CHL_CPCT_ID is null and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' and deal.DEALDATE <=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and deal.STATUS !='D' group by DEAL.PROD_ID,DEAL.CCY

SELECT sum( case when deal.CUR_ASSET_TYPE in ('01','03','05','08','10','12') then -1*nvl(deal.AMT,0) else nvl(deal.AMT,0) end ) cashamt ,DEAL.PROD_ID,DEAL.CCY FROM chb_invest_trade deal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=deal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where deal.trade_type !='02' and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' and deal.DEALDATE <=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and deal.STATUS !='D' group by DEAL.PROD_ID,DEAL.CCY

SELECT SUM(UNINVEST_CASH) CASHAMT FROM( select DISTINCT UNINVEST_CASH,PLAN_ASSET_ID from chb_bot_ast_pos where PLAN_ASSET_ID in (SELECT DISTINCT ASSET_CODE FROM chb_invest_trade deal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=deal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where deal.trade_type='05'and deal.status !='D' and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03') and pos_date=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and status !='D')

with ap as( select DISTINCT UNINVEST_CASH,PLAN_ASSET_ID from chb_bot_ast_pos where PLAN_ASSET_ID in (SELECT DISTINCT ASSET_CODE FROM chb_asset_position deal left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd on prd.PROD_ID=deal.PROD_ID and prd.status !='D' where deal.trade_type='05' and prd.PROFIT_TYPE='03' and deal.CDATE=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE}) and pos_date=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and status !='D' and UNINVEST_CASH !=0), aq as(select sum(cp.accuqty) qty,cp.ASSET_CODE from chb_asset_position cp INNER join ap on ap.PLAN_ASSET_ID=cp.ASSET_CODE where cp.CDATE=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP by cp.ASSET_CODE) select cp.PROD_ID prodId,Round((cp.accuqty/aq.qty)*ap.UNINVEST_CASH,2) cashamt, AP.PLAN_ASSET_ID oldAssetCode,ci.ccy from chb_asset_position cp INNER join ap on ap.PLAN_ASSET_ID=cp.ASSET_CODE left join aq on aq.ASSET_CODE=cp.ASSET_CODE left join chb_asset_info ci on ci.ASSET_CODE=AP.PLAN_ASSET_ID and ci.status !='D' where cp.CDATE=#{cdate,jdbcType=DATE}

WITH ap AS ( SELECT DISTINCT decode(cbap.ASSET_CODE,'REMAININGCASH',cbap.POS_AMT,cbap.UNINVEST_CASH) as UNINVEST_CASH, cbap.PLAN_ASSET_ID,cbap.TOTAL_NUM FROM chb_bot_ast_pos cbap inner join chb_asset_position deal on cbap.PLAN_ASSET_ID=deal.ASSET_CODE and deal.trade_type = '05' and deal.CDATE = #{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} inner join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd ON prd.PROD_ID = deal.PROD_ID AND prd.status != 'D' AND prd.PROFIT_TYPE = '03' where cbap.pos_date = #{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} AND cbap.status != 'D' AND (cbap.ASSET_CODE = 'REMAININGCASH' or (cbap.UNINVEST_CASH !=0 and not exists(select TT.PLAN_ASSET_ID from chb_bot_ast_pos TT where TT.ASSET_CODE = 'REMAININGCASH' and cbap.PLAN_ASSET_ID =TT.PLAN_ASSET_ID)) ) ) SELECT cp.PROD_ID AS prodId , Round(cp.accuqty / ap.TOTAL_NUM * ap.UNINVEST_CASH, 2) AS cashamt , AP.PLAN_ASSET_ID AS oldAssetCode, ci.ccy,prd.IS_FHXGCP isFhxgcp FROM chb_asset_position cp INNER JOIN ap ON ap.PLAN_ASSET_ID = cp.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN chb_asset_info ci ON ci.ASSET_CODE = AP.PLAN_ASSET_ID AND ci.status != 'D' LEFT JOIN CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prd ON prd.PROD_ID = cp.PROD_ID WHERE cp.CDATE = #{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} AND prd.PROFIT_TYPE = '03'
and cp.prod_id in
null) OR cp.prod_id in (
#{prodid}

select
from CHB_ASSET_INFO where ASSET_CODE = #{assetCode,jdbcType=CHAR} and STATUS in ('E', 'M')

select prodInfo.PROD_ID as prodId,
case when prodInfo.OPERATE_MODE in ('01', '02') then prodInfo.MDATE
when ( select count(1) SCH_COUNT from CHB_PRD_OPENSCH where PROD_ID = #{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and STATUS in ('E', 'M') ) > 0 then
nvl(( select min(OPEN_START) MIN_OPEN_START from CHB_PRD_OPENSCH where PROD_ID = #{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and STATUS in ('E', 'M') and OPEN_START > #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} ), prodInfo.MDATE)
else null end as mdate from CHB_PRD_BASEINFO prodInfo where prodInfo.PROD_ID = #{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and prodInfo.STATUS in ('E', 'M')
